title: Wild Animals
text:
Lions are big wild animals. They live in Africa. Lions sleep for many hours during the day. At night, they hunt for food.

Monkeys are wild animals too. They live in forests and trees. Monkeys eat fruit and they play together. Many people like to watch them.

questions.text: When are lions most likely to hunt?
Why do many people like to watch monkeys?
options: Because monkeys play and are interesting

paragraph_translations: Leões são animais selvagens grandes. Eles vivem na África. Leões dormem por muitas horas durante o dia. À noite, eles caçam comida.
Macacos também são animais selvagens. Eles vivem em florestas e árvores. Macacos comem frutas e brincam juntos. Muitas pessoas gostam de observá-los.
